meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Cirq(Google 的量子计算框架)帮你用 Python 搭建、模拟量子电路,做噪声建模、电路转换与硬件运行准备,产出电路代码和模拟结果。
howto.when: 当你针对 Google Quantum AI 硬件、要设计噪声感知电路,或做量子表征实验时触发。它面向 Google 硬件、噪声建模与底层电路设计;IBM 硬件用 qiskit。

say.text: 用 Cirq 写一个两量子比特的贝尔态电路,模拟 1000 次
say.note: 生成电路并用模拟器采样出结果直方图

say.text: 给这个电路加上退极化噪声,对比不同噪声下的结果
say.note: 搭建含噪电路并逐个噪声水平分析

say.text: 把这个电路编译到 Google 硬件门集,检查量子比特连接
say.note: 输出适配设备的编译与路由方案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Cirq, Google's quantum computing framework, to build and simulate quantum circuits in Python, model noise, transform circuits and prepare hardware runs, producing circuit code and simulation results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you target Google Quantum AI hardware, design noise-aware circuits, or run characterization experiments. Suited to Google hardware, noise modeling and low-level circuit design; use qiskit for IBM hardware.

say_en.text: Write a two-qubit Bell state circuit in Cirq and simulate 1000 shots
say_en.note: Builds the circuit and samples a result histogram

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare results at different noise levels
say_en.note: Builds noisy circuits and analyzes each noise level

say_en.text: Compile this circuit to a Google hardware gateset and check qubit connectivity
